label: Слышать
description: A full conjugation deck for слышать: 2nd-conj endings on an -ать verb, present persons, past, future, and the perfective услышать.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular present. 'Слышу' takes the 2nd-conjugation -у despite the -ать infinitive. 'Красивую музыку' is the accusative object — the core government слышать + accusative.
Strategic focus: Second-person singular present. 'Слышишь' shows the telltale -ишь, a 2nd-conjugation ending on an -ать verb. 'Меня' is accusative; the question is a common spoken check-in.
Strategic focus: Third-person singular present. 'Слышит' ends in -ит, the 2nd-conjugation marker despite the -ать infinitive. 'Странный шум' is the accusative object in a plain statement.

Strategic focus: Third-person singular present, feminine subject. 'Слышит' keeps the 2nd-conjugation -ит. 'Знакомый голос' is the accusative object; the verb form is identical regardless of subject gender.
Strategic focus: First-person plural present. 'Слышим' takes the 2nd-conjugation -им. 'Всё' is the accusative object; the ё is required and must be typed exactly.
Strategic focus: Second-person plural present. 'Слышите' takes the 2nd-conjugation -ите. 'Мой вопрос' is accusative; this form also serves as the polite singular 'you'.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural present. 'Слышат' takes -ат, not -ют — a 2nd-conjugation ending on an -ать verb. 'Громкий смех' is the accusative object, closing the person ladder.

Strategic focus: Government with the preposition о. 'Слышу' is first-person singular present. 'О тебе' is prepositional: слышать о + prep means hear about — a second valid pattern alongside the accusative.

missions.phrase: Говори громче, я ничего не слышу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Negation with the genitive. 'Слышу' is first-person singular present. 'Не слышу' triggers the genitive 'ничего' — a high-frequency everyday complaint.
Strategic focus: Past tense, masculine. 'Слышал' is the masculine past, formed from the -а- stem. 'Дверной звонок' is the accusative object; past endings agree with gender, not person.
Strategic focus: Past tense, feminine. 'Слышала' adds the feminine -а. 'Эту песню' is the accusative of песня; the stem -слыша- stays constant across past forms.
Strategic focus: Past tense, neuter. 'Слышало' takes the neuter -о, agreeing with neuter 'ухо'. 'Каждый звук' is the accusative object; the neuter past is rare but regular.
Strategic focus: Past tense, plural. 'Слышали' takes the plural -и for all genders. 'Далёкий гром' is accusative; plural past ignores person entirely.
Strategic focus: Imperfective future. 'Буду' carries the person and number. 'Слышать' stays in the infinitive; this compound future describes ongoing future hearing.
Strategic focus: Imperfective future, second person. 'Будешь' marks second-person singular. The lexical verb 'слышать' remains an infinitive — only the auxiliary conjugates.
Strategic focus: Perfective past. 'Услышал' adds the prefix у- to mark a completed act of hearing. 'Шаги' is accusative plural; the perfective signals a single finished moment.
Strategic focus: Perfective future. 'Услышишь' is perfective present-form but future in meaning, with the 2nd-conjugation -ишь. 'Сам' adds emphasis; no auxiliary is needed for perfective future.

Strategic focus: Perfective future, third person. 'Услышит' keeps the 2nd-conjugation -ит and means will hear once. 'Важный ответ' is accusative; contrast with imperfective 'слышит' (hears generally).
Strategic focus: Perfective past, plural. 'Услышали' is the completed plural past. 'Хорошую новость' is the accusative object; the у- prefix frames the news as a single received event.

missions.phrase: Они до сих пор слышат хорошо.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Third-person plural present with an adverb. 'Слышат' uses -ат, the 2nd-conjugation plural on this -ать verb. 'Хорошо' is an adverb, so no object follows.
